name: molang
description: Molang for Minecraft Bedrock add-ons: errors in the game's own words, completion, hover and formatting, in .molang files and pack JSON.

commands.title: Show Molang regions in this file
commands.enablement: editorLangId == molang || editorLangId == bc-minecraft-molang || editorLangId == json || editorLangId == jsonc

commandPalette.when: editorLangId == molang || editorLangId == bc-minecraft-molang || editorLangId == json || editorLangId == jsonc

molang.catalogue.path.markdownDescription: Path to a `catalogue.json` to use instead of the one shipped with the extension.

molang.diagnostics.unknownQueries.markdownDescription: Severity for a query name that does not resolve where it is written: not in the catalogue, or not one the field can name. `default` is an error, as the game refuses to load the expression.

enumDescriptions: Read a pack file's Molang at its format_version.
Read Molang at no version: version-gated queries are not checked.
molang.versionSource.markdownDescription: The version a JSON file's Molang is read at, which decides the queries that were added or removed in a version. `format_version` takes the file's own, as a best-effort rule: behaviour-pack files and resource-pack client files alike, geometry excepted (its `format_version` is the geometry format's). A file without one is read at no version.

molang.json.schemaDetection.markdownDescription: Also read as Molang the strings the JSON schemas VS Code applies to a file mark as Molang (from extensions, `json.schemas` or the file's `$schema`), where the shipped path catalogue has no entry. **Molang: Show Molang regions in this file** shows which source found each string.

molang.json.enabled.markdownDescription: Molang features inside JSON files (animation controllers).

molang.json.completion.markdownDescription: Molang completion inside JSON strings. `auto` turns it off while the Blockception extension offers its own, so the two lists are not doubled.

molang.json.semanticTokens.markdownDescription: Semantic highlighting of Molang inside JSON strings. `auto` turns it off while the Blockception extension is active: only one extension's highlighting can apply to a JSON file.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/build.mjs --integration && node dist/test/runIntegration.js
scripts.test:web: npm run build && node scripts/build.mjs --web-tests && node dist/test/runWeb.js
